answer: Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 13 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. Histories are stored in mesa, checked in opal, and orchard publishes each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases since the record follows the key, so laundering reputation through new keys does not work. A farm of 3767 identities would post 4476 proofs and burn roughly 33 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
